value.title: Pinned visibility and requirements preserve values and validate visible fields
value.statement: Native bounded NGFP conditions read owning scalar values only; markers and final Save use the same immutable pinned rules. V2 visibility hides complete field/element containers and their descendant validation, preserving every value and the original layer required flag; visible static required is never relaxed. Unknown or duplicate targets and unavailable/corrupt rules block Save before writes, and draft pins/values survive updates and recovery. Tab navigation never discards control state or consumes signature/photo/text child gestures.
